$comment: Reviewer identities for zheref/kro-pwa, read by `nen pr ready` (CON-32). Declared as DATA so the readiness verdict is deterministic for every pull request: without this file nen refuses to judge rather than guess a reviewer set. This is a single-maintainer consumer repository: the human merge at G2 is the approval, so no default approver is a machine identity. Copilot reviews automatically once at open; Cursor Bugbot posts a check and reviews only when it has findings.

reviewers.$comment: Posts as copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]. Reviews once when the PR opens; nothing re-requests it after a push, so under the bounded policy only a PENDING request owes a round.
reviewers.name: copilot

reviewers.$comment: Cursor Bugbot posts under a login carrying either word and its check name varies with the installation -- an unanchored, case-insensitive substring.
reviewers.name: bugbot

reviewers.$comment: The maintainer. The human merge at G2 is the real approval; this row exists because an empty approval set is refused, and it names who that human is.
reviewers.name: zheref

delivery.$comment: No delivery bot or integration branch exists in this repository yet; the pattern matches nobody so no PR is judged as a delivery PR.
